notes: Direct fetch worked (no WAF); Shopify store, exact qty via /collections/<handle>/products.json paged and deduped by product id (Rule 1 - never trusted collections.json products_count field, which is a separate inflated counter not used here). Site has 626 total Shopify collections, the vast majority of which are marketing/filter roll-ups (price bands e.g. all-below-1000, discount-% bands, room-based e.g. bedroom/living-room/bathroom, color bands, seasonal/festive, curated theme lines e.g. 'The Allure of Gold', 'Cast Iron Collection', B2B pages) or brand/collection listing pages - all excluded per NEVER EXTRACT rule and mixed-roll-up rule. Category tree built from the site's own header nav dropdown (Decor / Kitchen & Dining / Lighting / Wall Decor / Bath Decor / Furniture), the authoritative product-type taxonomy the site itself presents, cross-checked against the full collections.json list for any additional genuine standalone product types (chess sets, drinkware) and against parent-vs-children product-count reconciliation to catch roll-ups. Exclusions: Aroma Candles (fragrance), Basins/Bath Sets (bath-accessories collection inspected - all soap dispensers, toothpaste dispensers, bathroom organizer sets = functional bathroom fixtures, not decor; all-bath-decor sub-collections excluded), all Furniture (all-furniture, tables-storage, garden stools), Fan Lights/ceiling-fan-light combos, Hanging Bulbs, French Floral Chandeliers (thematic subset of Chandeliers, not additive), Kettles/Casseroles (kitchen appliances/cookware), Bar Accessories (bar tools), Jewellery Organisers/Cushions (non-decor storage/textile), Kitchen Accessories/Storage Essentials/Placemats (kitchen storage/textile), Faux Flower Arrangements & Faux Sticks/Branches (explicit exclude). 'Table Top Decor' (71 products) and 'Figurines' (126) dropped as mixed roll-ups after inspecting titles - Table Top Decor mixes Human Figurines, Crystal Candle Stands, Clocks, Chess pieces, sand-timers already counted elsewhere (per mixed-roll-up rule: drop, don't pad). 'Decorative Storage' (14) dropped after inspecting titles - predominantly laundry baskets and a storage cabinet (furniture/textile), not decor. 'Decorative mirrors' (5, alt handle) skipped as duplicate of the primary 'Mirrors' collection (7). classic-wall-prints/wall-art/3d-wall-art skipped as overlapping thematic subsets of Handmade Paintings (272), which is the nav-declared parent Wall Art category (site's own 'Wall Decor' collection totals 325 products vs 38+7+272=317 from declared children, confirming no large uncounted residual). Several candidate collections returned 0 products and were dropped as retired/empty: dinner-sets, sculptures, bookends, wind-chimes, napkin-rings, charger-plates, wine-glasses, religious/divine-idols, pooja-room, bath-decor. No duplicate-company match found in prior archived c*.json extractions for 'Decor Kart' / 'decorkart'.
